_help: Named OSM objects drawn by their own shapes instead of the generic icon. Key: the OSM name tag of a statue, fountain or other scenery object. Units are metres from the object's point, +y down the screen (south); scale multiplies all of them, heights too. 3D shapes join the building layer, with perspective, winter snow on top and sun shadows: ["box", x, y, width, depth, bottom, top, colour] (x, y its centre) and ["cylinder", x, y, bottom radius, top radius, bottom, top, colour] (top radius 0 is a cone). Flat ground shapes, drawn under them: ["circle", x, y, radius, colour], ["rect", x, y, width, height, colour], ["polygon", [x1, y1, x2, y2, ...], colour], ["line", x1, y1, x2, y2, width, colour]. Colours are HTML hex, #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa.

Toripolliisi.note: Oulu's 2.2 m bronze bobby on the market square (Kaarlo Mikkonen, 1987); scaled 1.5x to read from the taxi
